subject: Upcoming Team Building Event - RSVP Required
body: Dear Team, We are excited to announce our upcoming team building event scheduled for next Friday, October 15th. The event will be held at the local park and will include team-building activities, games, and a BBQ lunch. Please RSVP by Wednesday, October 13th, so we can finalize the arrangements. We look forward to seeing you all there! Best regards, [Company Name]
